info.name: Arthur GenAI Engine Agent Discovery Tenant Signup API

items.docs: Public tenant signup. Accepts try-it-out onboarding form data, persists an onboarding submission, and creates a new organization, a default demo task scoped to that org, and a TENANT-USER API key with `org_scope` set to the new org. Returns the four identifiers; the raw `api_key` value appears only in this response (the DB stores only its hash). Gated by GENAI_ENGINE_DEMO_MODE — returns 404 when disabled.
